chapter: Early drum sets and dance-hall era
title: Drum sets before he started
summary: He and Allen discuss the old kits: overhead cymbal, tom-tom, tambourine, whistle, ratchet and wood blocks.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: What did drummers have back then? They had a Well before you started playing They had those Overhead cymbals And kind of overhead

foot pedal, snare, a bass drum, and what else? Well they had this, I don't know what you call it, a chani, something, a chani name of tom-toms they had. The guys had several of these, a tambourine used to hook up and use that too.
How many tom-toms did they have?
Well the more than that one I'm telling you and the tambourine. Just one of them? Yeah, I don't know what you call it, chani something, I don't know the name of it.
Yeah, well I know what you mean.
You know what I'm talking about.
Yeah, yeah, he's the only guy I believe Ronny still has one too.
Yeah. And what else? Did they have anything else at all?

Well some guys, some of the drummers, well Faiso in particular, I know he did, he had a whistle he used to blow when they'd play waltzes like that, he used to blow that whistle and play those waltzes with a whistle. And another thing, they had something they had on the side of the drum, they used to turn it like that and make it like a rattle.

It was hair done on the drums too. Oh yeah, and I left off that side symbol, he said they had those. He said that's one of those whistles you can slide up and down like that. Yeah, that's right. I saw you making the motion. Yeah. What kind of, would they have a wood block or a Chinese?

Yeah, they had wood blocks, some of them had wood blocks. Temple blocks? Yeah, same kind of block like we used. Same wood blocks. Yeah. Well them that didn't have wood block, they'd beat on the side of the rims of the drum, the bass drum, you know. Them that didn't have wood block.
I've seen some of those temple blocks, have you ever seen those? No, I haven't. Bill had some of those big huge things and they beat on them, kind of gives a sound like horses or something, you know.
No, I think I know what you're talking about.
Yeah, well Bill had some around here.
